test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
You are discussing the poor actions of a colleague. Select a synonym for the highlighted word.

She was often __**oblivious **__to the potential consequences of her actions.
solution:
The correct answer is **"unaware". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word in the question is **"oblivious". **

 
 
• **​**Its English meaning refers to being unaware or not conscious of what is happening around. ("अनजान").
 
• **Example: **"He was so engrossed in his book that he was oblivious to the world around him."
 
 
 
• The correct synonym for **"oblivious" **in this context is **"unaware", **which means not having knowledge or awareness. ("बेखबर").
 
 
• **Example: **"She walked into the room, completely unaware of the surprise party waiting for her."
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 2". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"obvious" **means something that is easily perceived or understood; clear, self-evident, or apparent. **("स्पष्ट").**
 
• **"barely" **means only just; almost not. **("मुश्किल से").**
 
• **"proficient" **means competent or skilled in doing or using something. **("कुशल").**
